title: Rav Shayya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Zevachim 34b he said, “It stands to reason as Rav Ashi says.” Hyman reports that in Chullin 58b, Dikdukei Soferim reads “Rav Shayya said to him,” whereas the text he uses reads Rav Oshaya.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Dikdukei Soferim gives Shayya; Hyman’s text gives Oshaya.

The William Davidson text of Zevachim 34b fully names Rav Shayya and Rav Ashi; its Chullin 58b paragraph reads Rav Oshaya. The Dikdukei Soferim reading is Hyman’s report, not a fresh collation of that work.
